_notes: PENDING (audit A3-07, 2026-10-13): no AI code reads these numbers yet. Only a doctrine's id acts (SquadTactics.DOCTRINES' option biases); the squad AI still uses its own constants, so changing a number here changes nothing in a fight until it is wired in and taken off '_pending' (and Doctrine.PENDING). Faction doctrine profiles (Captain, P0164 queue 17 part 6; every number proposed, for Captain's playtests). Each is meant to bias decisions the squad AI already makes (SquadAI, Doctrine): engage_m how far out it picks targets (m; audit F-03: fitted to the sight ranges, never past what the shooter sees, SquadAI.SIGHT_RANGE 300 m for hostiles and SQUAD_SIGHT_RANGE 300 m for the squad, nor its weapon's reach: Doctrine.engage_m clamps; insurgents hold fire until 240 m and regulars until 280 m, inside their 300 m sight, the PMC at its M4/Mk18's 300 m, which is also all it sees); reaction a factor on the time to the first shot at a new target; aim_deg degrees of aim error added; burst a factor on burst length and burst_pause on the pause between bursts (suppressive fire volume); cover_fire_s how long after the last sight of the enemy it keeps putting covering fire on where they were; frag_cooldown_s seconds between one unit's frags, frag_wait_s how long an enemy must stay hidden or behind cover before a frag goes in; morale_shaken and morale_broken the morale under which aim suffers and under which it falls back (or may give up); advance_after_s how long a hostile waits without sight before pushing a bound toward the enemy, and flank (0..1) how far to the side that bound goes. 'sides' gives each side's doctrine when none is set on the squad or the unit; hostiles follow their zone's people ('nations', by Names nation; 'hostile' when the nation isn't listed).
